Command-line passwords, a password in prose, and random tokens near a trigger
word, by character class and length. See README.md for the format.

=== secret command_password mysql attached password
mysql -uroot -p'⟦MySq1Ro¦otPw⟧' -h db.internal app

=== secret command_password mysql long option
mariadb-dump --password='⟦Mar1aDu¦mpPw9⟧' --all-databases > all.sql

=== secret command_password curl user and password
curl -u admin:'⟦CurlAdm¦1nPass⟧' https://jenkins.internal/api/json

=== secret command_password sshpass
sshpass -p '⟦SshP4ss¦W0rd⟧' ssh deploy@bastion.internal

=== secret command_password docker login
docker login -u ci -p '⟦D0ckerL¦oginPw⟧' registry.acme.example

=== secret command_password redis cli
redis-cli -h cache.internal -a '⟦Red1sCl¦iAuth⟧' ping

=== secret command_password openssl pass
openssl enc -aes-256-cbc -in backup.tar -out backup.enc -pass pass:'⟦EncB4ck¦upPw9⟧'

=== secret command_password htpasswd batch
htpasswd -b -c .htpasswd admin '⟦HtP4sswd¦Batch⟧' && echo done

=== secret prose_password password is
the password for the staging database is '⟦Stag1ngD¦bPw42⟧' until Friday

=== secret prose_password my password was
I reset it, my new password is '⟦N3wPassw¦0rdRst⟧' so try again

=== secret prose_password passphrase in prose
the passphrase is '⟦c0rrectH¦0rseBatt⟧', keep it in the vault

=== secret random_near_trigger base62 token after a phrase
the staging token is '⟦Zq7Lm2Pv¦Tn8sRb3Yc6Ud1Ef0Gh5Ij⟧'

=== secret random_near_trigger base64 secret after secret
client secret '⟦Hk2Wq8Zr+Lp5Vn/¦Xt3Ym9Bc7Jd1Fs6=⟧' for the sandbox app

=== secret random_near_trigger hex key after api key
api key: '⟦9f8e7d6c5b4a39¦28176f5e4d3c2b1a0f⟧'

=== secret random_near_trigger urlsafe token after bearer word
use the bearer value '⟦tY6_uI8-oP0aS2d¦F4gH6jK8lZ1xC3vB⟧' in the test

=== secret random_near_trigger base32 token after credential
the credential '⟦JBSWY3DPEHPK3PXP¦KRUGS4ZANFZSAYJA⟧' was rotated

=== secret random_near_trigger mixed token after access key
access key '⟦pQ4wE7rT1yU9iO3a¦S6dF2gH8jK5lZ0x⟧' expires soon
